## Our Foundation

## The Carta difference

![Connected data blocks in isometric view](https://images.ctfassets.net/y88td1zx1ufe/4V2QjVe6NmfeJsOrFbKU2G/845c753c838c82c5011071e3e2950df2/Multitask.svg)

### Total command

Gain real-time visibility and control of data and workflows—from a single investment to an entire fund structure—on one easy-to-use platform.

![Automation](https://images.ctfassets.net/y88td1zx1ufe/2DgwiMHWZ7DvZwnjhq9Ff6/9473a7f7ad1fe95dc3bc3fb6098ed765/Automation.svg)

### Agentic intelligence

Supercharge productivity and accuracy with context-aware agentic monitoring, proactive orchestration, and process automation.

![Insight](https://images.ctfassets.net/y88td1zx1ufe/3IrNav4PtRlOU18L2NZRJf/7f7a8eb8a272febbc57db61486a21a0c/Insight.svg)

### Strategic modeling

Extract powerful interconnected insights that help you quickly model new scenarios, formulate winning strategies, and make smarter decisions.

![Clarity](https://images.ctfassets.net/y88td1zx1ufe/78t3BU5fhWyTj3V5EKiMwO/80ddf62f23c43e5bed039b04bc156e47/Clarity.svg)

### Confidence & compliance

Enjoy enhanced data accuracy and traceability—and less time chasing errors—which means smooth and assured report, audit, and tax processes.

![Frictionless](https://images.ctfassets.net/y88td1zx1ufe/6fszHSzKz8g04cFvyXu5IL/52da6d8127c1c596631b56170c4bed76/Frictionless.svg)

### End-to-end collaboration

Keep everyone in sync with frictionless workflows and comms between firms, companies, investors, partners, and every player in between.

![Human](https://images.ctfassets.net/y88td1zx1ufe/7AmHe6AEbs2FV5K6Z8jWuV/527cd597677349764795c123ee8fece6/Human.svg)

### World-class expertise

Tap into Carta’s bench of seasoned pros—fund admins, tax experts, analysts and more—who deliver unmatched knowledge to inform decision-making.
